name: PLATO SDP Benchmark (7th DIMACS Challenge)
description: Independent benchmarking evaluation of 10 semidefinite programming (SDP) solvers on 50 problems spanning 12 problem categories, conducted as part of the 7th DIMACS Implementation Challenge. The benchmark covers a wide variety of SDP problem types including combinatorial relaxations, control, and graph problems. Error analysis and comprehensive performance tables are provided for all solver-problem pairs.
typical_sota_score: Solvers evaluated: SDPA, SeDuMi, CSDP, DSDP, SDPT3, MOSEK, LOQO, BMPR, BMZ, BUNDLE. Performance varies widely by problem category.
reputation: Historic but foundational SDP benchmark from the DIMACS Implementation Challenge series; widely cited in the SDP solver literature.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Funded by NSF-CISE-9981984. Published August 2002; historical benchmark, not updated since.
